Race-inspired 160cc naked. SmartXonnect Bluetooth on top variant. Proven platform with RTR DNA.

FZS with additional headlight surround styling and USB charging. Slightly premium FZ variant.

155cc naked hyper naked with R15 V4 engine, VVA, dual-channel ABS, traction control. Aggressive Dark MT styling.
155cc fuel-injected naked. SEP engine, single-channel ABS. Smooth and refined city commuter with sportbike feel.
Full-faired 155cc sports bike. SEP engine, single-channel ABS. Good entry-level faired sports bike for highway.
249cc oil-cooled naked with dual-channel ABS. Strong bottom-end torque, smooth, reliable Suzuki quality.

249cc liquid-cooled naked. Dual-channel ABS, TFT display, ride modes. Hero's premium sports naked.

200cc liquid-cooled Duke. Dual-channel ABS, trellis frame, WP suspension. Great city hooligan, aggressive character.
249cc liquid-cooled Duke with TFT display, dual-channel ABS, cornering ABS, traction control, quickshifter option.
399cc LC4c engine. Cornering ABS, traction control, quickshifter, 5-inch TFT, ride modes, cruise control. Benchmark 400cc naked.

Full-faired 373cc supersport. Cornering ABS, quickshifter, traction control, TFT display. Track-oriented ergonomics.

BMW entry naked. 313cc liquid-cooled single, dual-channel ABS, inverted forks. Premium build for the price. Made in India.
Full-faired 313cc sports bike. BMW-designed body, 4 ride modes, TFT display. Made in India in partnership with TVS. Limited Edition also available.
Best budget adventure bike India. 21-inch front wheel, 190mm ground clearance, 13L tank, dual-channel ABS. Rally-ready chassis.
210cc updated XPulse with more power, TFT display, larger ground clearance. Top budget adventure pick for Himalayan trips.
249cc adventure tourer. Dual-channel ABS, adventure ergonomics, upswept exhaust. Good value mid-size ADV.
334cc liquid-cooled adventure. 21-inch front wheel, 220mm ground clearance, dual-channel ABS, turn-by-turn navigation. Good value ADV.
249cc adventure. WP Apex suspension, dual-channel ABS, off-road ABS mode, TFT display, 14L tank. Good lightweight ADV.
452cc Sherpa engine, 21-inch front wheel, 200mm suspension travel, 17L tank, Google Maps TFT, ride modes. India's premier ADV bike.

Off-road focused 390 Adventure variant. Higher seat, longer suspension travel, spoke wheels with tubeless option. Best KTM for Ladakh.
Entry BMW adventure. 313cc single, 220mm ground clearance, dual-channel ABS. GS DNA at accessible price. Made in India with TVS.
296cc parallel twin adventure. 17L tank, large windscreen, dual-channel ABS. Excellent tourer with parallel-twin refinement. Highway comfort.
471cc parallel twin ADV. Dual-channel ABS, traction control, Honda Selectable Torque Control, TFT display. Good mid-size tourer.
649cc parallel twin tourer. 21L tank, large windscreen, dual-channel ABS. Excellent long-distance tourer for India. Smooth twin power.
1043cc inline-4 tourer. KTRC traction control, KIBS cornering ABS, rider aids. Premium long-distance touring machine.
India's most popular bike. 349cc J-platform, modern naked styling, dual-channel ABS. Low seat height, accessible for beginners.
Classic Bullet heritage bike. J-platform engine, dual-channel ABS, tubeless tyres. Iconic thumper for cruising Indian roads.
Bestselling retro motorcycle India. J-platform 349cc, dual-channel ABS, USB charging. Timeless styling, comfortable long-distance tourer.
349cc cruiser. Low seat height (765mm), 15L tank, Tripper navigation pod, dual-channel ABS. Great relaxed tourer.
Beach cruiser-inspired retro. Based on Classic 350 with beach/retro styling cues. Dual-channel ABS. Niche lifestyle model.
452cc Sherpa engine in naked/roadster form. Lower, sportier stance than Himalayan. Dual-channel ABS, TFT display. Urban 450 option.
648cc parallel twin cruiser. Very low seat height (740mm), Tripper navigation, dual-channel ABS. Premium Indian cruiser.
648cc parallel twin bobber-style cruiser. Upright riding position, dual-channel ABS. Sporty cruiser with 650cc twin punch.
648cc parallel twin retro roadster. Dual-channel ABS, excellent build quality, great real-world usability. Classic British-style styling.
648cc cafe racer. Rear-set footpegs, clip-on handlebars, sporty seating. Dual-channel ABS. Not ideal for pillion due to low seat.
648cc twin-engine classic retro. Timeless Classic 350 styling with 650cc twin. Dual-channel ABS, Tripper navigation.
648cc adventure/scrambler crossover. Upswept exhaust, high ground clearance, 19-inch front wheel. Dual-channel ABS.
348cc Honda Bluetooth-equipped retro. Dual-channel ABS, smartphone connectivity, 15L tank. Refined Honda quality in retro package.
CB350 with neo-retro scrambler-inspired styling. High-mounted exhaust, larger handlebars. Dual-channel ABS.
294cc J-Panther liquid-cooled retro. Dual-channel ABS, assist/slipper clutch. Jawa retro styling with modern mechanicals.
334cc bobber-style cruiser. Single seat, low slung, dual-channel ABS. Niche lifestyle bike for bobber enthusiasts.
334cc J-Panther engine in retro Jawa styling. TFT display, dual-channel ABS, assist/slipper clutch. Premium Jawa 42 variant.
334cc retro roadster. Neo-retro Yezdi styling, dual-channel ABS, turn-by-turn navigation, USB charging.
Updated 2026 334cc scrambler. 19-inch front wheel, 200mm clearance, 3 ride modes, traction control, dual-channel ABS. Rs 2 lakh launch price.
160cc budget cruiser. Very low seat height (735mm) ideal for shorter riders. Single-channel ABS. Good relaxed tourer for budget riders.
220cc cruiser with cruise bar, low seat, windshield. Single-channel ABS. Affordable long-distance highway cruiser.
225cc modern cruiser with multi-surface riding. SmartXonnect Bluetooth, dual-channel ABS, USB-C. Versatile urban-touring crossover.
Made-in-India Harley with Hero partnership. 440cc single-cylinder, dual-channel ABS, eSIM connectivity (S variant). Entry Harley cruiser.
440cc liquid-cooled cruiser by Hero MotoCorp. Dual-channel ABS, TFT display, ride modes. Hero's most premium bike.
296cc parallel twin fully-faired. 17L tank, dual-channel ABS. Good beginner supersport with long-range capability.
498cc parallel twin faired sport. Successor to Ninja 400. Dual-channel ABS, assist/slipper clutch. Great mid-range sport tourer.
649cc parallel twin faired sport. Dual-channel ABS, assist/slipper clutch. Excellent sport-touring balance. Highway capable with good comfort.
649cc parallel twin naked. Dual-channel ABS, assist/slipper clutch. Naked counterpart of Ninja 650. Sporty city and highway bike.
948cc inline-4 naked. Dual-channel ABS, ride modes, TFT display. Aggressive supernaked. Best for weekend blasts.
998cc supersport. WSBK-derived tech, Cornering ABS, KCMF. 200+PS. Track weapon, limited practical usability in India.
636cc supersport inline-4. Dual-channel ABS, KCMF chassis management. High-revving track-biased motorcycle.
659cc parallel twin supersport. Aprilia Traction Control, Cornering ABS, quickshifter, 5-inch TFT. Lightweight supersport benchmark.
659cc naked version of RS 660. Cornering ABS, traction control, quickshifter, winglets. Sporty everyday naked.
457cc parallel twin entry Aprilia naked. Dual-channel ABS, traction control, TFT display. Made-in-India Aprilia model.
1252cc Revolution Max V-twin. 3 ride modes, cornering ABS, traction control. Sporty Harley, small fuel tank limits range.
1252cc Revolution Max adventure flagship. Adaptive ride height, Cornering ABS, multiple ride modes, 21L tank. Premium ADV experience.
649cc cruiser with adjustable ergonomics (Ergo-Fit system). Very low seat height (705mm). Dual-channel ABS. Very accessible cruiser.
449cc parallel twin cruiser. Low seat height (730mm), dual-channel ABS, retro Eliminator styling. Accessible mid-size cruiser.
660cc inline triple adventure tourer. Cornering ABS, 4 ride modes, 17L tank, full TFT display. Excellent sport-adventure tourer.
177cc classic retro. Vintage W-series styling, affordable entry point. No ABS. Tube-type tyres. Lightweight retro commuter.
776cc parallel twin ADV. Motion Track Brake System (cornering ABS), traction control, multiple ride modes, 20L tank. Top-tier mid-size ADV.
233cc dual-sport adventure. Trail-oriented bike, very lightweight. Small fuel tank limits long tours. Good for trail riding.
975cc Revolution Max 975T. Rider-assist package, 2 ride modes, cornering ABS. Sporty Harley cruiser with compact dimensions.
